title: fix(plugin-report): tolerate jsdom hex colors in conditional-formatting test
body:
[CI run #25539753515](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/25539753515/job/74962941457) failed on a single assertion in `ReportViewer.test.tsx`:

```
AssertionError: expected '#bbf7d0' to be 'rgb(187, 247, 208)'
```

Recent jsdom releases preserve the raw hex value in `HTMLElement.style.backgroundColor` instead of normalizing it to `rgb(...)`, so a strict equality check is environment-fragile.

### Changes

- **`packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/ReportViewer.test.tsx`** — relax the conditional-formatting assertion to accept either representation:

  ```ts
  expect(wonCell?.style.backgroundColor).toMatch(
    /^(rgb\(187,\s*247,\s*208\)|#bbf7d0)$/i,
  );
  ```

- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — record under `[Unreleased] › Fixed`.

No production code touched; the negative branch (`expect(lostCell?.style.backgroundColor).toBe('')`) is unaffected since both jsdom versions agree on the empty string.
